newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Multi-Choice has 65,000 digital users.
newsitem.headline: Multi-Choice has 65,000 digital users.

text.p: South African satellite broadcaster MultiChoice has signed up 65,000 subscribers to its digital television network in less than a year of its existence, decoder supplier Pace Micro Technology said on Tuesday.
The service is growing at 6,000 new subscribers a month, the firm added.
Pace predicted that the coming Christmas sales period would see a flurry of new sales as retailers push prices down.

"We have been meeting with leading chain store buyers over the past few weeks and it is clear the satellite industry has now been recognised for its massive potential," said Laurie Knight, Pace director for Africa and the Middle East.

The satellite market in South Africa is set to undergo a boom in the next six months with Christianity-based broadcaster Uplink planning a new digital network and AstraSat looking to launch a service using older, but cheaper, analogue technology.
MultiChoice already runs an analogue channel, M-Net, with nearly a million subscribers.
